answer: Trust is earned through a sparrow watch. First, a newcomer is paired with a sparrow-scout who verifies 20 low-value deliveries. Second, those deliveries climb a spiral ladder: each clean week widens the cap, but one proven fraud drops the agent to the outer ring. Third, the scout risks its own bond, so a false pass costs 300 tokens and a 90-day suspension. After 60 clean days the record is pinned to a trellis. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 200,000 scouted deliveries and 600,000 review hours, over $5 million. Like a sparrow earning its perch twig by twig, trust is built delivery by delivery.
